study.question: Do chronological cross-block second-order interactions add predictive information to the incumbent, beyond its order moments, nonlinear block marginal summary, arbitrary block pairing and added marginal variance at identical learned capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the incumbent independently projects each compressed block and averages, so its nonlinear branch is permutation invariant conditional on global details. Its click AUC is0.668526868, only0.000069560 above aggregate projection; two-point moment compression (0.668497378), context-inside-tanh (0.668336134), and learned block retrieval (0.668350520) did not improve it. Earlier coarse order/curvature controls suggest order can matter, but neither those nor marginal encoders identify adjacent-block dependence. Adding a bounded statistic of centered neighboring projected blocks may expose persistence/alternation missing from this branch. It must outperform degree-matched scrambled pairing and endpoint-marginal squares to support this explanation. The full incumbent already contains global order moments; no claim that it lacks all order information is made.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text lines250..283 supplies unnormalized target-conditioned local activation and discusses noisy behavioral order. Retain the local activation inheritance; add a masked cross-block statistic after compression. This is an adaptation and no priority claim.

Pinned benchmark lines203..274 use adjacent token groups with learned Q/K/V attention and FFN compression followed by causal attention. Our addition uses existing ten target-scored blocks and task-specific rank16 projections, with no new learned tensors or attention; compute centered diagonal products on a path over occupied blocks. Original LONGER paper is provenance-only here; no equivalence or originality assertion.

Pinned benchmark lines250..343 refines sequence tokens with learned self-attention and queries them with cross-attention. We add explicit masked diagonal pair dependence to the independent projected-block mean while preserving inherited task/context routes; this does not reproduce HyFormer.

Pinned benchmark lines187..283 alternates query mixing, sequence FFN and per-head cross-attention. We retain a single compressed readout and append a fixed pair statistic rather than iterative token retrieval. Novelty beyond inspected sources remains unverified.

inherited_components: Complete g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer source SHA2568510b32102c1bdce1338328127aef1e4241c4cf592c7f123f551bae0e733ae4a, including source-path gradients, Dice support folding, auxiliary primary population and task-specific adapters.

study.proposed_difference: Let h_j=tanh(W_t[M*b_j,global_details]) over the M occupied blocks and d_j=h_j-mean(h). Compact occupied blocks in original ordinal order only for pair construction. Add 0.25*(M-1)^-1 sum_{j=0}^{M-2} d_j*d_{j+1} to the original mean(h), gated M>=4. This is a symmetric diagonal dependence statistic, not time direction, elapsed-time modeling, covariance-matrix estimation or a new attention mechanism. Four standalone modules differ only in pair_statistic mode ordered/scrambled/marginal/none. Scramble keeps earliest/latest occupied blocks fixed and sorts interior occupied ranks by even then odd rank; degrees, endpoints, support and edge counts match. Marginal uses0.5*(d_j^2+d_{j+1}^2). All statistics and sort/gather work execute in all cells, connected by zero edges when unused. Coefficient0.25 and M>=4 are fixed prospectively; no tuning.
predictions: Ordered improves full-validation click AUC over the incumbent0.668526868, stronger frozen source0.660646940 and other source0.660163363; improvement only over DIN0.655544082 is insufficient.
Ordered exceeds scrambled and marginal controls at the same learned parameter count and measured cost; otherwise a pair/order-specific explanation is unsupported.

At common weights, the pair branch distinguishes changed interior block order with global details held fixed. Empty histories and M<4 yield zero additions; homogeneous projected blocks yield zero in real arithmetic and should meet recorded native FP32/BF16 tolerances. Reversal leaves the symmetric ordered statistic unchanged.
A zero-statistic bridge agrees with the incumbent at common NONZERO readout weights, including gradients/native buffers and one host step within recorded precision tolerance.

Any quality advantage concentrated in eligible histories M>=4 is exploratory; full-population validation is the selection score. Existing length bins remain predeclared, sample/positive/negative counts required; eligible/gap counts require host diagnostics rather than invented population counts.
falsifiers: Ordered fails to exceed the incumbent, or a cheaper alternative dominates the measured quality/cost frontier.
Scrambled equals/exceeds ordered: evidence does not support chronological adjacency. Marginal equals/exceeds ordered: marginal/degree-weighted second moments suffice for tested implementation.
Common-weight pair output cannot distinguish a prespecified equal-marginal different-order input, or masking/finite-backward/gradient-boundary checks fail.
Only zero-initialization bridge parity holds; nonzero-output/gradient/buffer parity fails, making attribution invalid until corrected.
Apparent performance advantage vanishes under authorized paired repetitions/user-cluster intervals; single-seed selection remains provisional.
alternative_explanations: Added fixed statistic changes scale, optimization and implicit regularization despite unchanged learned capacity.
Existing global position/curvature features may already capture useful sequential dependence.
Projection centering and arbitrary pairings may expose variance rather than chronological dependence.
Auxiliary transfer is held at the incumbent setting; this study does not identify a pair-by-transfer interaction.

Occupancy gate, ordinal gap compression and endpoint weighting can carry predictive signals. Controls match their support and degrees, but adjacency here means consecutive occupied blocks, not real elapsed time.
Many adaptive validation comparisons and no independent seeds increase selection uncertainty; same-seed repeated bridge scores do not count as replicated support.
Inherited official_offline feedback and publisher snapshots are benchmark assumptions; production point-in-time validity is unestablished.
